name: capabilities

primitives.title: List chat channels
primitives.description: Lists chat channels followed by the authenticated user, including direct-message channels.

primitives.title: Create chat message
primitives.description: Creates a message in a chat channel as the authenticated user.

primitives.title: List bookmarks
primitives.description: Lists the authenticated user's bookmarks.

primitives.title: List events
primitives.description: Lists upcoming events whose posts are visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: List categories
primitives.description: Lists the visible category hierarchy.

primitives.title: Create category
primitives.description: Creates a category and returns its ID, slug, and name.

primitives.title: Create group
primitives.description: Creates a group and returns its ID and name. Requires group creation rights.

primitives.title: Create post
primitives.description: Creates a reply in a topic as the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Create private message
primitives.description: Creates a private message as the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Create tag group
primitives.description: Creates a tag group. Requires staff authority and tagging enabled. Tags use ID or name selectors; synonyms resolve to original tags. Name selectors require allow_tag_creation=true and may create tags. permissions maps group IDs to full or readonly; group 0 means everyone. Omitted permissions default to everyone/full.

primitives.title: Create theme
primitives.description: Creates a theme or theme component with optional HTML, SCSS, and settings fields.

primitives.title: Create topic
primitives.description: Creates a topic as the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Create user
primitives.description: Creates a user as an administrator. Registrations must be open. Supply the site's invite code if required and required user fields keyed by field ID. Missing-field errors identify the field name and ID.

primitives.title: Get current user
primitives.description: Returns the authenticated Discourse user, granted scopes, and MCP server URI.

primitives.title: Delete category
primitives.description: Deletes an empty category after confirming its current name.

primitives.title: Delete draft
primitives.description: Deletes one of the authenticated user's drafts at its current sequence.

primitives.title: Delete group
primitives.description: Deletes a group after confirming its current name. Administrators only. Automatic groups cannot be deleted.

primitives.title: Delete tag group
primitives.description: Deletes a tag group and its membership, permission and category relationships, including required-tag rules. Tags and topic tags remain. Requires staff authority, tagging enabled, confirm=true and the exact current expected_name.

primitives.title: Delete theme
primitives.description: Deletes a theme and its component links. Requires edit permission, the current name, and confirmation. Default and system themes cannot be deleted.

primitives.title: Filter topics
primitives.description: Discover topics through a filtered, top, or hot view. Filtered uses Discourse TopicsFilter syntax; top uses Discourse's top score and defaults to weekly; hot is daily top. Returns a uniform topic projection and truthful pagination metadata.

primitives.title: Get category
primitives.description: Reads category details needed for category management.

primitives.title: Get chat messages
primitives.description: Reads a bounded page of messages from a visible chat channel.

primitives.title: Get draft
primitives.description: Retrieves one of the authenticated user's drafts by key.

primitives.title: Get group
primitives.description: Gets safe details and caller capabilities for one visible group.

primitives.title: Get post replies
primitives.description: Read reply relationships for a post as recursive descendant IDs, bounded rich direct replies, or the upstream-bounded ancestor history. Preserves upstream ordering and references.

primitives.title: Get post revision
primitives.description: Returns a post revision visible to the authenticated reviewer.

primitives.title: Get Data Explorer query
primitives.description: Returns the definition of a saved Data Explorer query. Requires an admin account.

primitives.title: Get report
primitives.description: Retrieves one report from the caller's current report catalog. Requires staff access; admin-only reports and related items retain their normal restrictions. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and default to the last 30 days ending on end_date or today. Date ranges cannot exceed 366 days. Filters accept scalar values or arrays, as supported by each report. limit bounds rows only where the report supports it; omitting it preserves that report's default. cache opts into the existing report cache and requires administrator access; include_related_items defaults to false. This runs registered reports, not arbitrary SQL.

primitives.title: Get review queue count
primitives.description: Returns the number of pending reviewable records visible to the authenticated reviewer.

primitives.title: Get reviewable
primitives.description: Returns one visible reviewable with its current version, evidence, and available actions.

primitives.title: Get tag group
primitives.description: Reads tag-group configuration, including tags, parent, one-per-topic policy and permissions. Requires staff authority.

primitives.title: Get theme
primitives.description: Reads a theme or theme component and its fields. Requires administrator access.

primitives.title: Get topic view stats
primitives.description: Get up to 300 ascending daily topic view counts. Views combine anonymous and logged-in views; they are not unique viewers or an engagement judgment.

primitives.title: Get user
primitives.description: Reads a user profile visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Get user moderation summary
primitives.description: Returns staff-visible moderation counters for a user.

primitives.title: Get user summary
primitives.description: Returns profile-visible aggregate activity for a user.

primitives.title: Handle group membership request
primitives.description: Approves or denies one pending membership request for a group the authenticated user may manage. Approving adds the requester to the group.

primitives.title: Install theme
primitives.description: Installs executable theme code from exactly one repository URL or base64 archive. Requires administrator access and confirmation. Repository installs always run migrations and require confirm_run_migrations. Archive migrations are opt-in. Archive component imports default to none; merge and sync require run_migrations and confirm_run_migrations. Only archives can replace an existing theme; confirm its current name before replacement. Returns a theme summary without source code and reports any archive components that could not be imported.

primitives.title: Invite group members by email
primitives.description: Adds existing accounts that match an address and invites the rest to the forum with the group preassigned. Requires permission to view email addresses.

primitives.title: Invite to private message
primitives.description: Adds one user or group, or submits one email invitation, to a private message.

primitives.title: List directory items
primitives.description: List user-directory metrics with authoritative totals and continuation. Supports Discourse periods, ordering, visible groups, page 0-10, and up to 50 rows.

primitives.title: List group members
primitives.description: Lists members and owners when the authenticated user may see them.

primitives.title: List group membership requests
primitives.description: Lists pending requests for a group the authenticated user may manage.

primitives.title: List group posts
primitives.description: Lists visible public-topic posts authored by members of a visible group.

primitives.title: List groups
primitives.description: Lists groups visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: List latest posts
primitives.description: List the site's latest visible posts using Discourse's fixed 50-post page and post-ID cursor. Results are a feed, not an exhaustive history.

primitives.title: List private messages
primitives.description: Lists a personal or group private-message mailbox visible to the user.

primitives.title: List reports
primitives.description: Lists the caller's available Discourse reports, including enabled plugin reports. Requires staff access. Use the returned report types with discourse_get_report.

primitives.title: List reviewable topics
primitives.description: Lists topic-level signals from pending reviewables visible to the authenticated reviewer.

primitives.title: List reviewables
primitives.description: Lists reviewable records visible to the authenticated reviewer, including their current actions.

primitives.title: List site settings
primitives.description: Lists admin-visible site settings while masking secret and credential-like values.

primitives.title: List tag groups
primitives.description: Lists staff tag-group inventory with permissions and parent tags, ordered by name and ID. Requires staff authority. Paginate with limit and offset; reads remain available when tagging is disabled.

primitives.title: List themes
primitives.description: Lists installed themes and components. Requires administrator access.

primitives.title: List user actions
primitives.description: Lists a user's visible activity using named action types.

primitives.title: List user posts
primitives.description: Lists a user's visible topics and replies with zero-based pagination.

primitives.title: List users
primitives.description: Lists and filters users visible through Discourse's staff user directory.

primitives.title: Manage group members
primitives.description: Adds or removes members of a group the authenticated user may manage. Provide exactly one of usernames, user_ids, or user_emails. The user_emails selector requires permission to view email addresses.

primitives.title: Manage own group membership
primitives.description: Joins a group that allows public admission, leaves a group that allows public exit, or requests membership with a reason.

primitives.title: Manage group owners
primitives.description: Grants or revokes group ownership. Adding an owner also adds them as a member. Automatic groups cannot be changed.

primitives.title: Manage user activation
primitives.description: Activates, approves, activates and approves, or deactivates an eligible user.

primitives.title: List notifications
primitives.description: Lists the authenticated user's notifications.

primitives.title: Perform reviewable action
primitives.description: Performs one currently available action on a visible reviewable after a fresh permission check.

primitives.title: Delete or recover own post
primitives.description: Deletes or recovers a post owned by the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Set post reaction
primitives.description: Adds, changes, or removes the authenticated user's reaction to a visible post.

primitives.title: Read post
primitives.description: Reads one visible post.

primitives.title: Read private message
primitives.description: Reads a private message visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Read topic
primitives.description: Reads a topic and a bounded set of posts visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Read selected topic posts
primitives.description: Read exact, earliest, latest, around-post, or username-filtered topic evidence. Selection is bounded to 50 posts and reports the visible stream size without claiming the entire topic was loaded.

primitives.title: Reply to private message
primitives.description: Replies to a private message visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Run Data Explorer query
primitives.description: Runs a saved Data Explorer query that the authenticated user can access.

primitives.title: Save draft
primitives.description: Creates or updates a draft for the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Search Discourse
primitives.description: Searches topics and posts visible to the authenticated user using Discourse search syntax.

primitives.title: Search posts
primitives.description: Search post-level evidence with Discourse query syntax. Preserves matched posts, highlighted excerpts, authors, topics, categories, and bounded continuation. This is keyword search, not semantic search.

primitives.title: Search tag groups
primitives.description: Searches visible tag groups and visible member tags. Omits staff configuration. q and names combine; q supports SQL LIKE wildcards. truncated signals possible additional results.

primitives.title: Set accepted solution
primitives.description: Accepts or unaccepts a post as the topic solution when permitted.

primitives.title: Sync remote theme
primitives.description: Checks a theme repository for updates or installs its latest code. Requires edit permission. Updating runs migrations and requires both code and migration confirmation. Checking also updates stored remote-version metadata. Returns a theme summary. When completing a pending installation, also reports skipped components with their errors.

primitives.title: List tags
primitives.description: Lists visible tags ordered by usage.

primitives.title: List topics
primitives.description: Lists recent topics visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Set topic vote
primitives.description: Casts or removes the authenticated user's vote on a visible votable topic.

primitives.title: Update category
primitives.description: Updates basic details for a category.

primitives.title: Update group
primitives.description: Updates the group settings the authenticated user may change. Fields the user cannot change are ignored.

primitives.title: Update post
primitives.description: Edits a post when the authenticated user has permission.

primitives.title: Update site setting
primitives.description: Sets or resets one ordinary site setting after a current-value check and explicit confirmation.

primitives.title: Update tag group
primitives.description: Updates supplied fields, preserving omitted fields. tags replaces all member tags; [] clears them. parent_tag=null clears the parent. permissions replaces the full permission map. Synonyms resolve to original tags. Name selectors require allow_tag_creation=true. Requires staff authority and tagging enabled.

primitives.title: Update theme
primitives.description: Updates attributes and fields on a theme when the authenticated user may edit it.

primitives.title: Update theme setting
primitives.description: Sets a declared theme setting or restores its declared default. Requires edit permission. Use pipe-separated strings for list settings and arrays of objects for object settings. Reverting requires confirm and must omit value.

primitives.title: Update theme translations
primitives.description: Updates declared theme translations for one locale. Requires edit permission and the current theme name. Unknown keys reject the whole batch.

primitives.title: Update topic
primitives.description: Updates fields on a topic when the user may edit it.

primitives.title: Update user
primitives.description: Updates the authenticated user's own profile.

primitives.title: Upload file
primitives.description: Uploads base64 data or a remote HTTP(S) file for the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Upload theme asset
primitives.description: Uploads base64 asset data for use in a theme. Requires administrator access. Returns an unattached upload ID; use discourse_update_theme to attach it to a theme field. Site upload and MCP request-size limits apply.

primitives.title: Set user status
primitives.description: Sets or clears the authenticated user's status.

primitives.title: Discourse post
primitives.description: A post visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Discourse topic
primitives.description: A topic visible to the authenticated user.

primitives.title: Draft a reply
primitives.description: Builds a prompt for drafting a grounded reply to a visible topic.

primitives.title: Research discussions
primitives.description: Builds a prompt for researching visible Discourse discussions.

INSERT INTO mcp_oauth_authorizations (id, user_id, mcp_oauth_client_id, resource, status, consented_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (601, 1, 501, 'http://localhost/mcp', 'active', now() - interval '1 day', now() - interval '1 day', now() - interval '1 day'), (602, 3, 501, 'http://localhost/mcp', 'active', now() - interval '1 day', now() - interval '1 day', now() - interval '1 day')

INSERT INTO mcp_oauth_authorization_scopes (id, mcp_oauth_authorization_id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (701, 601, 'mcp:profile:read', now(), now()), (702, 601, 'mcp:themes:write', now(), now()), (703, 602, 'mcp:profile:read', now(), now())

INSERT INTO mcp_oauth_access_tokens (id, token_hash, mcp_oauth_authorization_id, mcp_oauth_client_id, user_id, resource, scopes, grant_version, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (801, 'hash-a', 601, 501, 1, 'http://localhost/mcp', '{mcp:profile:read,mcp:themes:write}', 1, now() + interval '1 hour', now(), now()), (802, 'hash-b', 602, 501, 3, 'http://localhost/mcp', '{mcp:profile:read}', 1, now() + interval '1 hour', now(), now())
